title: What Is It Like to Become an Astronaut?

image.attribution: NASA/David Scott / Wikimedia Commons / Public Domain.

main_content:
Colonel Terry Virts always knew he wanted to be a pilot or an astronaut.

He had pictures of galaxies and planes on his walls as a child. He never thought he could actually become an astronaut, but he did the things he had to do to qualify. He got a mathematics degree, went into the Air Force, and eventually became a test pilot. In 2000, he was accepted to the astronaut candidate program.

As an active astronaut with the U.S. Space Program Virts has one of the most demanding jobs in the world. He has flown the space shuttle, conducted spacewalks, and was the commander of the International Space Station in spring 2015.

questions.question: What did Terry Virts have to do to qualify for an astronaut position?
options: He had to write a book on space travel.
He needed to complete a mathematics degree, serve in the Air Force, and become a test pilot.
He had to win a national flying competition.
He was required to undergo physical training for six months.
questions.answer: He needed to complete a mathematics degree, serve in the Air Force, and become a test pilot.

questions.question: What did Virts do as an astronaut?
options: He led the design of new spacecraft.
He flew the space shuttle and commanded the International Space Station.
He trained new astronauts through simulations.
questions.answer: He flew the space shuttle and commanded the International Space Station.
